statements.__comment: This is a clean-up statement to remove custom attributes
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(cluster:GKECluster) WHERE cluster.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL REMOVE cluster.exposed_internet, cluster.exposed_internet_type, cluster.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: A cluster is internet-exposed when its control plane has a public IP endpoint (private_endpoint_enabled false; NULL from older syncs means public) that anyone can reach: master authorized networks off, an authorized block of 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0, or Google Cloud public IPs allowed. Public nodes alone do not expose the control plane.
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(cluster:GKECluster) WHERE coalesce(cluster.private_endpoint_enabled, false) = false AND (coalesce(cluster.master_authorized_networks, false) = false OR any(block IN coalesce(cluster.master_authorized_cidr_blocks, []) WHERE block IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) OR cluster.gcp_public_cidrs_access_enabled = true) SET cluster.exposed_internet = true

statements.__comment: This sets the exposed_internet_type for exposed GKE clusters; public_nodes is only an extra type on an already exposed cluster
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(cluster:GKECluster) WHERE cluster.exposed_internet = true WITH cluster, coalesce(cluster.master_authorized_networks, false) AS man SET cluster.exposed_internet_type = ['public_endpoint'] + CASE WHEN man = false THEN ['no_master_authorized_networks'] ELSE [] END + CASE WHEN man AND any(block IN coalesce(cluster.master_authorized_cidr_blocks, []) WHERE block IN ['0.0.0.0/0', '::/0']) THEN ['master_authorized_networks_open'] ELSE [] END + CASE WHEN man AND cluster.gcp_public_cidrs_access_enabled = true THEN ['gcp_public_cidrs_access'] ELSE [] END + CASE WHEN coalesce(cluster.private_nodes, false) = false THEN ['public_nodes'] ELSE [] END

statements.__comment: This generates the publicContext for exposed GKE clusters
statements.query: MATCH (:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPOrganization{id:$GCP_ORGANIZATION_ID})-[:OWNER]->(:GCPProject{id: $GCP_PROJECT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(cluster:GKECluster) WHERE cluster.exposed_internet = true SET cluster.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: cluster.id, resourceType: 'gcp-compute-gke-cluster', context: [{clusterId: cluster.id, clusterName: cluster.name, endpoint: cluster.endpoint, location: cluster.location, privateNodes: cluster.private_nodes, privateEndpointEnabled: cluster.private_endpoint_enabled, masterAuthorizedNetworks: cluster.master_authorized_networks, masterAuthorizedCidrBlocks: cluster.master_authorized_cidr_blocks, gcpPublicCidrsAccessEnabled: cluster.gcp_public_cidrs_access_enabled, exposureTypes: cluster.exposed_internet_type, status: cluster.status, currentMasterVersion: cluster.current_master_version}]}])
